title: Trailer kitchen and deck — pouring coffee
userInput: Becky pouring coffee in the trailer kitchen, looking out the sliding doors, early morning
expected: A photorealistic photograph of one adult woman standing at the laminate counter of a narrow trailer kitchen in early morning, pouring coffee into a mug while she looks out through open sliding glass doors onto a small wooden deck and the open grass beyond. She wears an oversized t-shirt and shorts with her hair loose and sleep-mussed; the counter is chipped laminate with a dish rack behind her and two mismatched chairs at a small table. Full body shot at eye level from inside the room, 35mm, natural skin texture, sharp focus.
